extension.summary: Repository for the Apple TV-inspired Kodi setup.
extension.description: A personal add-on repository for the Apple-TV-Kodi project.

addon.name: Orchard
addon.provider-name: Orchard (built on Estuary by phil65 and Ichabod Fletchman)

extension.summary: A streaming-style skin inspired by the Apple TV app.
extension.description: Orchard makes Kodi feel like the Apple TV app: a sidebar for Home, Movies, TV Shows and Apps, a rotating featured banner, rows of poster art, product pages with seasons and cast, and Apple's tvOS type scale and spacing. Built on Kodi's Estuary skin, so every Kodi screen keeps working.
